{{Scorpio}}
Scorpio 20 is the 328th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 20th day of Scorpio, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 47, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 12宮20日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 328|Chapter 328]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152347}}.
